shortDescription: Learn trading. Practice decisions. Simulated money only — not buy/sell signals.
fullDescription:
TradeAcademy by Aithera helps you learn trading through education and simulated practice.

The loop is Learn → Practice → Simulate → Review → Improve. Academy lessons teach concepts with charts and exercises. Practice drills train judgment. Paper trading uses labelled simulated capital (default $100,000 USD) — not a brokerage and not real money. Journal and Review grade reasoning, risk, and plan adherence. Simulated profit does not mean you made a good decision.

Anyone may download and explore Guest mode. Creating an account or purchasing a subscription requires being at least 18 (or the age of majority where required). A Teen Play rating is content suitability only — it does not mean a minor may legally trade.

TradeAcademy is not a broker, does not execute trades, does not handle real money, and does not provide buy/sell signals, guaranteed returns, or investment advice. Scores such as DQS measure process quality, never price direction.

Premium unlocks deeper Academy, Replay, Trading DNA, and review tools. Free remains a complete way to learn, practise, simulate, and journal. Monthly and yearly subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled in Google Play subscription settings. Lifetime is not offered. Cancellation stops renewal while access continues through the store-reported paid-through date. The yearly plan includes a 7-day trial only when shown on the Google Play purchase sheet.

Features:
• Academy paths with charts, exercises, and knowledge checks
• Practice drills and decision rooms
• Simulated portfolio (not real money)
• Journal and process review
• On-device educational mentor (not signals)
• Trading DNA from records you actually kept
